question: Ustad Amir Khan belonged to which of the following Gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Ustad Amir Khan**

__
 
• Also known as **Sur Rang.**
 
• one of the **greatest and most influential Indian vocalists in the Hindustani classical tradition__**.
 
• **Founder** of the **Indore Gharana**.
 
• His **singing style:** The __**amalgamation of Kirana and Bhendibazaar Gharanas.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** Gharanas

__
 
• A **community of performers** who share a **distinctive musical style** that** traces to a particular instructor or region.**
